We're excited to help you start your next home improvement project.Discover everything you need, all in one place, to get your car, home, and yard ready for the colder weather. We are your one-stop shop for log splitters, weather stripping, snow brushes, pipe insulation, and other must-have, cold-weather essentials that keep you prepared for the winter months. Find what you need stocked on the shelves at your local Reston Home Depot or skip the trip to the store with our fast, free delivery. We offer free pickup within two hours for millions of items using The Home Depot app. Returns are just as simple — start those in the app, too, or do them online. We make shopping quick and easy.At The Home Depot, we love giving back to our community. We support Reston-area schools and veterans with Team Depot projects.You can find us northeast of the intersection of Route 267 and Route 286, by the Trader Joe's. Drop by today and see what's new. Remember to check the local ad before you arrive to know which items are on promotion.Sincerely,Your Reston Store TeamFrequently Asked Questions About Your StoreIs there an appliance sale for Spring Black Friday 2026?Get some of the best bargains of the season with our Spring Black Friday Sale. Fresh patio furniture makes it easy to savor the spring air, and new tools help take care of that to-do list. It's also a great time for lawn and garden work outdoors, as well as setting up new appliances and cleaning indoors, all with new storage to stay organized. Don't forget to upgrade your grill and outdoor power equipment as well. Get it all done when you save during our spring sale, running only from April 9th through April 22nd. Don't miss out on these deals.How can I prepare my home for fluctuating spring temps?Be confident your home is ready for springtime weather changes by repairing or replacing faulty components of your hardscaping. On the exterior of your home, examine shingles or metal roofs for damage that can let water come in. Keep gutters functional and clear to prevent water overflow from seeping beneath your shingles when storms arrive. Chimney caps and vinyl siding should be changed out if they're in poor condition. Also, check cinder blocks and brick for cracks, and ensure indoor ceiling tiles are free from water damage. If moisture gets in the crevices, you might be in for a headache.What's your selection of moving boxes like?Make your move easier by picking up a mix of moving boxes. We've got the sizes you want, including specialty ones like wardrobe and TV boxes. Cushion your items with bubble cushion and moving blankets to ensure your belongings make it to your next location safely. Remember to check out our moving truck rentals if you need those as well.Why should I get a generator?Enjoy electricity in your home even after severe storms take it out. We've got the options you need when searching for a generator for sale. Inverter generators are cleaner and quieter than traditional portable generators. They adjust to whatever power load is requested. This means they'll make less noise while they create less power. When browsing generators, keep in mind that portable generators are more affordable and generate more electricity than inverter generators, but they're louder and heavier. Always run your generators outside, away from doors and windows, for safety purposes.Do you have doorbell cameras?Enjoy safety, peace of mind, and privacy with a wired or wireless doorbell camera. No more peeking through a nearby window when you can watch human or animal visitors in real time. Some doorbell cams even let you speak to whoever is at the door via your phone, a useful interaction for delivery people or to scare off potential porch pirates. Most cameras integrate with your smart home app or hub to give you flexible accessibility. Choose to save video clips for future reference as needed.Does the Reston Home Depot offer Curbside Pickup?Yes, you can pick up Curbside Orders from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. with The Home Depot app. Select "Curbside with The Home Depot App" at checkout when shopping eligible Store Pickup items. We'll let you know via email or text when your order is ready at the store. Bring a valid, government-issued photo ID with you.To pick up your Curbside Order: 1. Download The Home Depot App.2. Before you get to the store, use the link in your "Ready for Pickup" text message or email to tell us in the app that you're on the way.3. After you arrive, park in a designated Curbside Pickup spot. It's usually located near the entrance of the store.4. Check in through the app to tell us you're here.5. We'll bring out your order and load it into your vehicle.Learn more about Curbside Pickup.Recycling at The Home DepotPLASTIC BAG RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Plastic grocery bags, plastic wrap, and film plasticCOMPACT FLUORESCENT BULB RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Unbroken indoor/outdoor compact fluorescent bulbsRECHARGEABLE BATTERY RECYCLINGWhat Can Be Recycled?Common products:Undamaged rechargeable batteries used in power tools, cell phones, and laptopsNickel Cadmium (Ni-Cd), Lithium Ion (Li-ion), Small Sealed Lead Acid (SSLA/Pb), Nickel Metal Hydride (Ni-MH), Nickel Zinc (Ni-Zn)The Home Depot's core values are based on doing the right thing for our associates and customers.
